questions.stem: A green object is viewed under red light. What colour does it appear?
questions.explanation: A green object appears green in white light because it reflects green light and absorbs other colours. Under red light, there is no green light to reflect, so the object absorbs the red light and appears black.

questions.stem: What colour is produced when red light and green light are mixed together?
questions.explanation: When red light and green light are combined, they produce yellow light. This is an example of additive colour mixing. Red + blue = magenta, and green + blue = cyan.
